abstract: A 72-year-old woman was transferred to our hospital after being diagnosed with retroperitoneal and ovarian tumors. Abdominal computed tomography revealed a well-defined mass lesion measuring 35 mm on the dorsal side of the descending part of the duodenum that was surrounded by the head of the pancreas and inferior vena cava. In addition, a cystic mass measuring 90 mm was found in the pelvis. Hence, the patient was diagnosed synchronous retroperitoneal tumor and teratoma. Laparoscopic retroperitoneal tumor resection and right adnexectomy were performed. The pathological findings indicated that the retroperitoneal tumor was a diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and the pelvic tumor was a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. On the basis of the computed tomography findings, we judged that the tumor had a poor tendency to infiltrate and could be peeled off and resected using laparoscopic surgery. In this rare case, the retroperitoneal tumor and mature teratocarcinoma were simultaneously resected laparoscopically.
abstract_ja: 72歳の女性が、後腹膜腫瘍および卵巣腫瘍と診断され、当院に紹介された。腹部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では、十二指腸下行部背側に、膵頭部および下大静脈に囲まれた35mm大の境界明瞭な腫瘤性病変が認められた。また、骨盤内に90mm大の嚢胞性腫瘤が認められた。このため、同時性の後腹膜腫瘍および奇形腫と診断された。腹腔鏡下後腹膜腫瘍切除術および右付属器摘除術を施行した。病理所見では、後腹膜腫瘍はびまん性大細胞型B細胞リンパ腫であり、骨盤内腫瘍は卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。CT所見から、本腫瘍は浸潤傾向が乏しく、剥離して切除可能と判断し、腹腔鏡手術を選択した。本稀少症例では、後腹膜腫瘍と成熟奇形腫を腹腔鏡下に同時切除した。
